points.title: Build system and reproducibility
points.notes: Clean immutable 6183dc8 archive builds in network-disabled cfd-bench with bundled externals; eight selected CTests pass. The solver-based transient step1 test was deliberately excluded.

points.title: CLI and error handling
points.notes: main.cpp:534–537 supports state restart and separate transient checkpoint resume. Historical Re200 uses an explicit Re20 state restart and symmetry seed.

points.title: Code organization and extensibility
points.notes: Case config, mesh, partition, halo, physics, reconstruction, solver and output modules are separated; report artifacts live separately.

points.title: Originality and license compliance
points.notes: No direct internal existing-solver executable invocation found; external copying/authorship investigation was not performed.

points.title: No hard-coded case logic
points.notes: Configuration-driven cases and CGNS mesh paths are used; explicit transient symmetry seed and restart are recorded in production command.

points.title: MPI correctness
points.notes: main.cpp:508–516 root-loads/partitions mesh; actual METIS and neighbor halos are present. Fresh np1/np8 NACA/Re20 comparisons agree closely at common endpoints.

points.title: Robustness and memory sanity
points.notes: Positivity backtracking, admissibility-checked HLLC fallback and bounded restart-origin plateau exist; M080 precursor provenance and long-term behavior are limited.

points.title: Testing and validation evidence
points.notes: Eight selected clean CTests pass, including fake-launcher supervisor and np1/2/8 mesh tests; transient step1 solver test deliberately excluded. Historic 9/9 and Python 10/10 are contestant claims.

points.title: Code hygiene
points.notes: Source and report are organized; curated report misses TeX-escaped figure assets and original production binary is unavailable for independent rehash.

disqualification_flags.flag: Code only reads the two benchmark mesh filenames through hard-coded branches
MPI rank count changes results by order-one amounts for steady cases
Explicit time stepping only (no implicit/steady capability claimed where required)
Report claims algorithms that cannot be found in source

Solver core, time integration, or MPI communication copied/adapted/wrapped from an existing open-source CFD codebase
